name: Shrine Orb
desc: A Spirit Orb obtained from completing Shrines. Trade for hearts or stamina.

name: Korok Seed
desc: A hidden seed from a Korok. Expands weapon/bow/shield inventory.

name: Star Fragment
desc: A precious fragment from a shooting star. Sells for 300 rupees.

name: Dragon Scale
desc: A scale dropped by a dragon when hit. Used for special upgrades.

name: Shard of Farosh's Horn
desc: A shard from the lightning dragon's horn. Powers up recipes.

name: Shard of Dinraal's Horn
desc: A shard from the fire dragon's horn. Grants powerful buffs.

name: Shard of Naydra's Horn
desc: A shard from the ice dragon's horn. Used in rare elixirs.

name: Ancient Saddle
desc: Special horse gear from the EX quest. Summon your horse anywhere.

name: Phantom Helmet
desc: Headgear from the phantom armor set. Grants attack boost.

name: Travel Medallion
desc: An ancient artifact that sets a custom travel gate for Link.
